Training.Dataset: Polish Companies Bankruptcy (UCI Machine Learning Repository), 5year.arff: ratios of companies a year before the outcome
Training.Attribution: Tomczak, S. (2016). Polish Companies Bankruptcy [Dataset]. UCI Machine Learning Repository. https://doi.org/10.24432/C5F600
Training.Method: L2-regularised logistic regression (lambda 1) of ten ratios, each winsorised at the 1st and 99th percentile, standardised and clamped to three scales; a missing ratio counts as the mean; a ratio whose weight would go the wrong way (more profit, more risk) is left out and the others refitted
Training.Ratios: CurrentRatio=X4, QuickRatio=X46, EBITDAMargin=X49, ROA=X7, ROE=X1/X10, ROS=X42, DebtOnSales=X2/X9, LongTermLiabilityRatio=X2-X51, InterestCoverageRatio=X27, InterestOnSales=X42/X27
Training.Calibration: to the sample (bankruptcies are over-represented): not to any population of companies
Training.Caution: A demonstration of a trained model delivered as Access data. Trained on companies of Poland; not for real companies.
